Jensen Huang at GTC Berlin last month. | Photo: Soeren Stache / picture alliance via Getty Images	

Nvidia's board announced that Jensen Huang - its longtime co-founder, president, and CEO - has resigned after reports of two extramarital affairs, one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with an Nvidia executive who reported to Huang.
